record_type: Retained summary of the independent read-only pre-execution review; no cloud calls or broad test rerun by reviewer
verdict: No blocking finding for the reviewed automatic-minor-upgrade correction with the guard installed, verified and not overridden
checks: The policy permits Update:* generally and explicitly denies Update:Replace and Update:Delete for AWS::RDS::DBInstance; explicit denial takes precedence.
The frozen assembly differs from the original deployed template solely in Database.AutoMinorVersionUpgrade=false.
The reviewed change set included the direct database property change and dependent dynamic references; no added or removed resource was identified.
A Conditional replacement indication does not justify bypassing the policy: an attempted database replacement must fail under the guard.

Execution conditions were set/read-back policy, no temporary override, and post-update confirmation of unchanged database identifier/resource ID/endpoint, engine16.13, flagfalse and preserved original expiry.

The subsequently retained auto-minor-applied.json records UPDATE_COMPLETE, the matching policy hash, no override, same database identity and the required false flag. This is operator execution evidence, not a second cloud observation by the reviewer.
scope_notes: The optional QualificationConfigSecretArn empty parameter was absent from the older frozen template; disabled behavior was compatible, not a claim of literal equality with the newer parameter map.
If the guard refused execution, the prescribed action was to retain the failure and investigate rather than weaken the policy.
The stack policy guards CloudFormation updates only. It is not protection against direct RDS calls, IAM-authorized policy changes or deletion of the whole stack.
No runtime image, callback configuration, application authorization or general release readiness is certified by this review.
